title: Landauer's 1961 argument that erasing information has a physical cost
summary: Landauer's IBM Journal paper connects logical irreversibility with heat.
body: R. Landauer, "Irreversibility and Heat Generation in the Computing Process" (IBM Journal of Research and Development, 1961), argued that logically irreversible operations, such as erasing a bit, dissipate heat. The v1 entropy article invokes Landauer's principle for the claim that information is physical. This card records the paper. It does not restate a numerical kT ln 2 bound that was not re-read from the text.
